page_title: BUR 0-2 CRY | Burnley v Crystal Palace 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' 0 - 2 Goal! Eberechi Eze tees up Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 0:2.
90+4' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johann Berg Gudmundsson departs the field of play to be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.

90' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the left side of the goal. Sam Johnstone is alert, though, and makes a great save to deny him.
90' Burnley are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
89' Chance! Wilson Odobert (Burnley) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
86' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Jordan Beyer is replaced by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
86' Substitution. Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) has come on for Odsonne Edouard.
84' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Burnley.
84' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Sam Johnstone stops the ball from going inside the left post.
82' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Burnley.

81' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Sam Johnstone makes a brilliant save! It will be a corner kick for Burnley.
78' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Wilson Odobert (Burnley) replaces Luca Koleosho.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Nathan Redmond (Burnley) is brought on as a substitute for Zeki Amdouni.
77' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
74' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
73' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
70' Here is a change. Joel Ward is going off and Roy Hodgson gives the last tactical orders to Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
70' It's time for a substitution. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on in place of Jeffrey Schlupp.
69' Burnley are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
64' A goal, which was scored by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley), was disallowed due to offside.
63' The ball is behind the touchline and Crystal Palace will take a throw-in.
58' A substitution has been made. Cheick Doucoure goes off and Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) comes on.
55' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
55' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
52' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Vitinho (Burnley), but the defence gets it clear.
51' Peter Bankes interrupts the game. One of the players from Burnley won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
49' The ball has crossed the sideline. Burnley are taking a throw-in.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
45+3' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) gets a yellow card, off the field.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+1' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
45' Burnley take a short corner kick.
44' A cross into the box from Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is cleared. Now Burnley have a corner.
43' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and sends his close-range header well past the right post.
43' Burnley are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
41' The corner from Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) is hurriedly cleared.
40' A lofted cross from Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
39' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Sam Johnstone makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
39' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' Sander Berge (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Peter Bankes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
30' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
29' A player from Crystal Palace takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The linesman signals a throw-in for Burnley.
26' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

22' 0 - 1 Goal! Jordan Ayew plays in Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 0:1.
16' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.

16' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
15' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
14' Crystal Palace seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Burnley force their opponents to concede a corner.
10' Peter Bankes blows the whistle, Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is penalised for a foul.
9' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
8' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
5' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
2' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Peter Bankes.
